Download First Touch Soccer 2022 Mod Apk Obb Data files with latest player transfers, super high quality graphics, updated stadiums, real Players faces, improved player ratings and more.

First Touch Soccer 2022 Mod for Android is a offline soccer game in which you can start managing you own football club, buy high rated players and also sell under performing players, build and take your football team to the top of the league.

FTS 22 Mod Apk comes with improved features that is better than FTS 2021, everything is working super fine in FTS 2022 Mod for Android device without any issues.

Overall graphics quality for the game has been improved, which makes FTS 2022 look more dynamic for best gaming experience.

English Premier League was also updated including teams, logos and emblems, you can choose from any updated team available in the game.

Games modes such as Kick off, Start Player Match, Training mode can still be found in the new First Touch Soccer 22 Mod for Android. You can easily choose from this game modes and play anytime without using any internet data.

Career mode of First Touch Soccer 2022 Mod has greatly modified, once you start the career mode you will be welcomed with a new user interface which is similar to that of Dream League Soccer games.

Kits and logos for players or entire team has been updated in the latest 2022 version of First Touch Soccer a.k.a FTS, this kits patterns and designs matches the real world football club kits.

In FTS 2022 unlike any other edition of FTS also have unlimited amount of money or coins, this huge amount of money or coins enables you to buy new players, upgrade your team and buy other unlockable items within the game.

How To Install First Touch Soccer 2022 Apk Obb Data File

Obb Data file and Apk App are highly required to set up First Touch Soccer 2022 edition as this will enable you to see all the latest features available in the game. Carefully follow the steps below to install the game below.

 Watch Installation Video 

Steps To Install First Touch Soccer 2022:

  1. Install and open Zarchiver Apk App which also serve as file manager.
  2. Locate FTS 2022 Obb Zip file in downloads folder.
  3. Click on the Obb FTS 2022 Zip file, options Menu will come up, click Extract from the options menu and…
  4. Goto the top of Zarchiver app interface, tap on folder title and select “Device Memory” from the drop down menu.
  5. Scroll down a bit and click Android Folder, further click Obb folder and now..
  6. Click “Extract Icon” which looks like a arrow pointing down, obb file will be successfully extracted without any issues.
  7. To extract FTS 2022 Zip Data File follow similar steps above by clicking on Data FTS 2022 Zip file, then go to Device Memory, further click Android Folder, again click Data Folder and finally extract by clicking “Extract Icon”, after that install FTS 2022 Apk app you downloaded above.
